allowed_before_occurrence_access: record archive byte size and SHA-256
list ZIP member paths, compressed/uncompressed sizes, CRC32 and raw-member SHA-256
decode and summarize only the Darwin Core Event core
inspect Event-core identifiers, dates, coordinates, island/locality fields, protocol/remarks and phase-label text
construct response-independent candidate site keys from Event-core fields
derive response-independent temporal clusters from Event dates under the frozen rule below
forbidden_before_occurrence_access: summarize taxon identity, abundance or presence from the Occurrence extension
compute source loss, persistence, contraction or source-leverage effects

phase_audit.explicit_label_rule: search Event-core text fields only for case-insensitive whole-token BALA1/BALA 1, BALA2/BALA 2, BALA3/BALA 3; a row is explicitly labelled only when exactly one phase token is found

date_cluster_fallback.date_source: parsed Event-core eventDate or verbatimEventDate only
date_cluster_fallback.year_rule: extract the first valid four-digit year 1900-2100 from the first available date field
date_cluster_fallback.cluster_rule: sort distinct observed years; choose the two largest adjacent year gaps; require both gaps >= 3 years and unique in rank; split into exactly three chronological clusters
